name: PCTQualificationDTO
description: PCTQualificationDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

qualificationYear.description: The calendar year during which activity occurred.

averagePercentValue.description: The average percent capacity or heat input usage.

yr1QualificationDataYear.description: The first year corresponding to the qualification data.

yr1QualificationDataTypeCode.description: Code used to identify the type qualification in the first year.

yr1PercentageValue.description: The percent capacity or heat input usage in the first year.

yr2QualificationDataYear.description: The second year corresponding to the qualification data.

yr2QualificationDataTypeCode.description: Code used to identify the type qualification in the second year.

yr2PercentageValue.description: The percent capacity or heat input usage in the second year.

yr3QualificationDataYear.description: The third year corresponding to the qualification data.

yr3QualificationDataTypeCode.description: Code used to indicate type of data for year (actual or projected) used to determine peaking or gas-fired qualification.

yr3PercentageValue.description: The percent capacity or heat input usage in the third year.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification percentage record.

qualificationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.
